description: The file defines the 'ViewSugarpdf' class which extends 'SugarView'. It is responsible for generating PDF views using the Sugarpdf framework in SuiteCRM, including loading the appropriate Sugarpdf object, handling access control, and rendering output.

classes.name: ViewSugarpdf
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering PDF views within SuiteCRM, managing the lifecycle of the sugarpdf object, handling permissions, and outputting the generated PDF.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the view, loads the requested sugarpdf type, and handles missing request parameters by redirecting.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the sugarpdf object, performs access control checks, and assigns errors if present.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Processes and outputs the PDF to the browser.
